title.title: The Correspondence of the Yarnall family

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of the Yarnall family is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

div.p: If thou could with convenience call at our house when Thou art near in the city it would greatly oblige us; remember us affectionately to thy parents and tell we have no accounts from both becomingly resigned and peaceful and calm in spirit. They intended so to proceed as to lodge at D. Sand’s the 18th of last mo HJ grows stronger, bears thee trying separation from our beloved Friend, her husband, with much christian fortitude. We went in company to Germantown Meeting first day week, and she was better at her return than in setting out.
